content.description: Hands removing cam ring, rotor and vane plates from power steering pump housing

items: REMOVE CAM RING, ROTOR AND VANE PLATES

content.text: Be careful not to scratch the cam ring, rotor or vane plates.

content.description: Removing rotor shaft from power steering pump housing clamped in vise, showing chisel and hammer being used to pry off oil seal and snap ring pliers removing snap ring

items: (a) Clamp the front housing in a vise.

content.text: Do not tighten the vise too tight.

items: (b) Using a chisel and hammer, pry off the oil seal.
(c) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.

content.description: Using plastic hammer to lightly tap rotor shaft out of front housing

items: (d) Using a plastic hammer, lightly tap the rotor shaft out of the front housing.

content.description: Using plastic hammer to tap bottom end of rear housing and removing rear plate and spring

content.text: Using a plastic hammer, tap the bottom end of the rear housing, and remove the rear plate and spring.
Avoid gripping the rear plate with pliers as this could damage it.

content.description: Removing pressure port union, flow control valve and spring from power steering pump

items: REMOVE FLOW CONTROL VALVE AND SPRING

content.text: Use care not drop, scratch or nick this valve.

items: (a) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.
(b) Install a suitable bolt to the spring seat and pull it out.
